# Book

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A book used as a source in a PKM system.

## Scope note

- Includes properties about the book, author, publisher, etc.
- Created with a Book Template, and metadata captured by the Obsidian Book Search plugin.
- Query book using book title, author, publisher, or ISBN
- Uses Google Books API to get the book information and cover image for the Book note.
- Includes properties for title, subtitle, authors, categories, description, publisher, total pages, cover URL small cover URL, local cover image, publishDate, and ISBN.
